basics.founded: 2008 (deemed university status; began as Graphic Era Institute of Technology)
basics.type: Deemed to be University under Section 3 of the UGC Act, 1956
basics.ugc: Deemed university status granted in 2008 under Section 3 of the UGC Act, 1956
basics.other: Several B.Tech programmes accredited by NBA

placements.source: NIRF 2025 data submitted by Graphic Era University

admission: Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics; minimum marks vary by branch
Merit in Class 12, JEE Main percentile or CUET scores
Graphic Era's entrance test or personal interview; UCEED, NID DAT or NIFT scores are also accepted
CAT, MAT, XAT, CMAT, GMAT or GECET, then personal interview
Most other UG and PG courses

scholarships.text: Merit scholarships on tuition fee for the whole course, based on qualifying-exam marks (kept each semester with SGPA 7 or above). GECET, Graphic Era's scholarship test, offers tuition waivers of up to 100%. Girls get an extra 10% on net tuition fee, and wards of defence personnel a 5% concession.

hostel.text: Separate hostels for boys and girls, with Wi-Fi and dining halls.

fees.text: For the 2026 intake, first-year tuition is ₹2,13,800 per semester for B.Tech CSE (regular quota) and ₹90,000 per semester for BBA, before scholarships. Fees rise slightly each year.
